Questions we are often asked

How much does hair colouring cost at Studio 87?

We do not publish a fixed price list, because the price depends on your hair length, its condition and the colour you want. WhatsApp a photo of your hair to 017-977 3168 and we will tell you what it needs.

Do highlights damage my hair?

Lightening always changes the hair, so we check your hair first and tell you honestly what it can take. Ask us about a treatment with your colour if your hair is dry.

Which perm suits fine, flat hair?

A natural texture perm, which adds body without tight curls. We check your hair first and agree the curl size with you.

Do you style hair for dinners and weddings?

Yes. Curls, buns, chignons and evening upstyles are regular work for us; the photos on this page are from the salon. WhatsApp us the date and the look you like.

Can grey hair be covered without looking solid black?

Yes. We use a natural black-tea brown that blends the grey in, rather than a harsh solid black. We agree the shade with you in the chair first.

Which treatment do you use?

Our official posts name Nakano treatment, used alongside colour work. We choose the treatment after checking your hair.

Do you do men's perms?

Yes. We do the men's foil perm and a natural texture perm. WhatsApp us a photo and the look you want.

Thinking about a new colour?

Send a photo of your hair now and the look you like on WhatsApp. We reply with what it needs.
